messages:
Alex R: paging — alerts firing for high p95 latency on text-generation in eu-west-1 across multiple routes. spike started ~10:04 UTC. lots of 503s and elevated tail latencies. seeing similar but lower impact in eu-central.
IncidentsBot: INC-2026-0423: High latency detected in eu-west-1 · severity: high · affected services: text-generation, streaming. Pager duty: @oncall-eng paged.
Maya L: I'm on it, looking at recent deploys and autoscale events. checking mem/cpu on the serving hosts.
Samir P: adding logs — getting repeated "kv-cache-miss" + backend gRPC timeouts. looks like cache tier is saturated. tail latencies for tokenization step also spiking.
Alex R: good catch. try routing a portion of traffic to fallback model -redwood-medium-v2 and pause canary rollouts. can someone run quick traffic-shift?
Kelly (SRE): running route-shift: `rcli route shift --from=eu-west-1:prod-pool --to=eu-west-1:fallback-pool --pct=30`
Kelly (SRE): logs show initial shift healthy. p95 for affected route fell from 820ms -> 420ms for the shifted subset.
Maya L: I'm restarting cache nodes in pool A (eu-west-1-cache-a). doing a rolling restart to avoid cold-start storm.
Samir P: adding emergency caching config: enabling prefix-KV pinning for high-volume customers to reduce recompute. command: ```
POST /admin/cache/pin
{
  "prefixes": ["/chat/", "/completion/"]
}
```
Alex R: can we prepare a short status-page blurb for customers? need ETA, impact, and mitigation steps. keep it concise.
Kelly (SRE): Draft for status page: "We are investigating elevated request latencies for text generation in eu-west-1. Some customers may experience increased response times or occasional errors. We have routed traffic to fallback pools and are performing cache restarts. Mitigation in progress; expected partial recovery within 30 minutes. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
Maya L: +1. I'll add that we've paused ongoing canaries and rolled back the last model deploy in eu-west-1 (deployed 09:58 UTC) — that might help with any bad kernel selection.
Samir P: Customer-facing note (short): "We are aware of increased latency for text generation in EU. Our team has moved traffic to fallback capacity and is restarting cache nodes; you may see reduced performance for up to 30 minutes. No data exposure. Reach support@redwood.ai for urgent issues."
CustomerCommsBot: Proposed notification queued for review. Template: ```
Subject: Incident: Elevated latency in EU region (eu-west-1)
Body: Hello — we are investigating elevated latencies affecting text-generation in eu-west-1. Some API requests may see increased response times or transient errors. Mitigations: traffic shifted to fallback pools, cache restarts, canary rollbacks. Expected partial recovery in ~30 minutes; full recovery TBD. We will follow up with a detailed timeline and postmortem. - Redwood Inference Ops
```
Alex R: Good. @Kelly publish the status page update and send the notification to customers flagged as impacted in the last 6 hours. Use the support pipeline for high-value customers.
Kelly (SRE): done — status page updated (link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1791204321). sent targeted emails to customers with active sessions in the window.
Maya L: cache node restarts completed on pool A. observing fewer kv-cache-miss spikes. backend gRPC error rate trending down.
Samir P: monitoring shows p95 back to ~380-450ms across most routes. some residual 5xx for long-context requests — those are hitting tokenization timeouts.
Alex R: Expected recovery: partial within 30 minutes from mitigation start. full stabilization maybe 1-2 hours while caches warm and queued jobs drain.
Kelly (SRE): on-call handoff incoming in 12 minutes — @Maya you'll take next shift, I'll stay as backup for 20 more min. leaving runbook note: "If p95 > 600ms for > 10m, escalate to infra lead and run scale-up for fallback pool."
Maya L: taking handoff. added action items to incident doc: scale policies, customer outreach, postmortem owner (Samir).
Samir P: I'll own the postmortem. immediate RCA hypothesis: cache saturation combined with a canary model whose kernel selection caused hot-path CPU contention. need heap/kv metrics correlation and per-model kernel traces.
Alex R: 👍. After stabilized, we should: 1) run targeted evals against the canary model on a staging copy, 2) adjust autoscaler thresholds for cache nodes, 3) add a fail-open for tokenization step.
IncidentsBot: Incident INC-2026-0423 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to medium. Next update scheduled in 15 minutes.
Kelly (SRE): closing page for now, will keep monitoring. leave this thread for final notes and postmortem link once Samir posts it. :white_check_mark:
